$comment: v0.1.6 Phase 4a addition (2026-05-15). Reference recipe demonstrating the cross-domain crosswalk capability — NIST CSF (defensive controls) -> MITRE ATT&CK (offensive techniques) coverage matrix. Showcases what Crosswalker can do that other compliance tools can't: bridging defensive + offensive ontology domains within one query. Structurally modeled after the MITRE Mappings Explorer project structure; uses the `nist-csf-to-mitre-attack.sssom.tsv` realistic fixture for test data.

query.title: NIST CSF -> MITRE ATT&CK coverage matrix
query.description: Cross-domain pivot view: CSF subcategories (defensive) on rows, MITRE ATT&CK techniques (offensive) on cols, count of mappings in cells. Showcases bridging defensive + offensive ontology domains within one query — Crosswalker's distinguishing capability.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum mapping confidence to include in the pivot.

tactic_filter.description: Optional MITRE tactic name to filter the cols (e.g. 'Persistence'). Empty string = all tactics.
